tagline: Aspiring AI Engineer building systems across machine learning, computer vision, and full-stack product, not just slides.
description: Jeyadev R is an AI engineer and full-stack developer in Chennai, India, building machine learning, computer vision, RAG and production web systems.

roles.detailed: AI/ML Engineer · Full-Stack Developer · Applied Research

education.institution: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research
education.degree: B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics

bio: B.Tech student in AI and Data Analytics who learns by building. My work spans forecasting and risk models (air quality, mortality, cardiovascular risk), computer vision (number plate recognition, scene classification), NLP and RAG (a drug-food interaction classifier, a self-hosted RAG cluster), and applied finance (a commodity forecasting ensemble, a prediction-market trading bot). I also work as a full-stack developer, shipping production MERN and Next.js apps end to end, from UI to auth to deployment, and I prefer shipping a working version over polishing a slide. Outside of code, I am a Student Council Member at my college and currently interning across two cleantech companies.

experience.company: Sri Ramachandra Faculty of Engineering and Technology
bullets: Built AeroSight, a Prophet + XGBoost dual-model AQI/mortality forecasting toolkit with auto-generated PDF reports, placing 2nd at Research Day 2025.
experience.desc: Built AeroSight, an air quality analysis and forecasting toolkit combining Prophet and XGBoost dual-model forecasting to correlate pollution trends with public health/mortality data, with auto-generated multi-page PDF reports for monitoring stations. Presented the system at Research Day 2025, placing 2nd.

bullets: Shipped a production MERN web app (React/TypeScript + Node/Express/MongoDB) with JWT auth and Cloudinary uploads.
experience.desc: Built and shipped the company's production MERN-stack web app for the cleantech/solar energy business, using a React/TypeScript frontend on Vite and a Node/Express/MongoDB backend with JWT authentication, Helmet security hardening, and Cloudinary-based image uploads, taking it from internal prototype to live production deployment.

bullets: Building SaaS features and REST APIs for new product modules on the core MERN platform.
experience.desc: Promoted to build ASPCV CRM, a full-stack CRM extending the core MERN platform that covers the full customer lifecycle from lead to deal, project, installation, and support, plus HR/payroll/attendance, inventory, material requests, invoicing, and dynamic database-backed role-based access control.

bullets: Built and deployed the academy's training website (Next.js + Express/MongoDB) on a purchased domain via Cloudflare; promoted webinars and HVAC/cleantech course content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube.
experience.desc: Built and deployed Aspiration Cleantech Academy, a job-oriented training platform covering HVAC, entrepreneurship, digital marketing, and sales courses (Next.js frontend, Express/MongoDB backend), purchasing the domain and shipping it live on Cloudflare. Also planned and organized webinars, produced educational content for the platform's career tracks, and ran outreach campaigns across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube to grow webinar attendance and enrollment.

experience.company: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research
bullets: Representing students on the council, coordinating with faculty on campus initiatives and student affairs.
experience.desc: Student Council Member at SRIHER, representing student interests and coordinating with faculty on campus initiatives, events, and student affairs.

projects.title: ScamShield
projects.subtitle: Explainable Scam SMS Detector for India
projects.desc: Explainable, obfuscation-robust scam SMS detector for Indian messages (KYC, UPI, courier, digital-arrest scams). Undoes tricks like '0TP' and 'v e r i f y', highlights the words behind each verdict, and checks links for look-alike bank domains. Of 8 benchmarked models, the deployed calibrated linear SVM reaches 0.97 F1, matching DistilBERT.

projects.title: PHYS-TRUST Lite
projects.subtitle: Trust-Adaptive Physics-Informed Air Quality Sensing
projects.desc: Air quality estimation on one low-cost Arduino node (MQ135 + DHT11). A Kalman filter fuses sensor physics, room mass-balance physics and an LSTM-ensemble prior, weighting each by a live trust score, with a 90% conformal uncertainty band and fault detection. Live React dashboard, local Gemma 3 explanations, 9% lower error than fixed-weight fusion.

projects.title: Attendance ERP
projects.subtitle: Multi-Semester College Attendance System on the Edge
projects.desc: College attendance system built around real timetables: multi-hour labs marked once, partial exam days, one-off period swaps, and bunk detection. Mobile-first marking, timetable builder with conflict checks, a student planner that projects when attendance crosses the limit, and admin heatmaps with an audit log, all on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

projects.title: FRONTIER
projects.subtitle: Local AI Content Agent for a Discord Community
projects.desc: AI agent for a student tech community Discord server. Discovers hackathons, research and AI news, drafts posts in the author's writing style with a local LLM (Ollama / LM Studio), routes them to the right channel, and publishes only after human approval via a React dashboard or Discord buttons. Ships an MCP server for other AI agents.

projects.title: ASPCV CRM
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack CRM for a Cleantech Company
projects.desc: Full-stack CRM covering the full customer lifecycle from lead to deal, project, installation, and support, plus HR/payroll/attendance, inventory, material requests, invoicing, and dynamic database-backed role-based access control.

projects.title: sret-rag
projects.subtitle: Self-Hosted RAG on a 4-PC LAN Cluster
projects.desc: Built for offline AI access at college with zero cloud dependency. Fully offline, self-hosted Retrieval-Augmented Generation system distributed across 4 budget PCs on a LAN: a FastAPI gateway, dedicated embedder, FAISS vector index, and a llama.cpp/Qwen2.5 LLM node. ChatGPT-style UI, cited answers, embed caching, doc dedup, and session-based auth.

projects.title: PolyBot
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Prediction-Market Trading Engine
projects.desc: Autonomous trading engine for Polymarket prediction markets, with live order book/price ingestion, mispricing/momentum/news strategy scoring, on-chain execution via Web3, a risk management core, and a control-panel dashboard for monitoring and steering the bot.

projects.title: AbsorbAI
projects.subtitle: Clinical Pharmacokinetic Decision-Support Platform
projects.desc: Clinical decision-support platform simulating personalized drug behavior across ~45 drugs for doctor and patient roles. Features a 10-layer PK/PD engine, Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification, Bayesian updates, a pharmacological knowledge graph, and Gemma 1.5B LLM integration.

projects.title: Pollumap V3
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Air Quality Dashboard
projects.desc: Full-stack air quality dashboard for Chennai with live AQI charts, an interactive Leaflet map, XGBoost-powered 24-hour forecasts, an A* 'Healthy Routing' algorithm for least-polluted paths, source-apportionment breakdowns, and an IoT sensor dashboard.

projects.title: Market Oracle
projects.subtitle: Commodity Price Forecasting Ensemble
projects.desc: Commodity price prediction pipeline for the Mitsui Commodity Prediction Challenge, combining a 9-model ensemble (Chronos, NeuralProphet, NeuralCDE, Mixture-of-Experts, Temporal Graph Attention, Granger causality, regime detection) via a Bayesian meta-ensemble with confidence intervals.

projects.title: EcoSynth
projects.subtitle: Neuro-Symbolic Green Retrosynthesis Planner
projects.desc: AI-assisted retrosynthesis planner combining symbolic chemistry rules, RAG over literature/reaction data, and a green-chemistry scorer to propose, validate, and rank synthesis routes, with built-in hallucination detection and a React UI for exploring reasoning traces.

projects.title: HyperlocalAQ
projects.subtitle: Multi-Source Air Quality Modeling for Chennai
projects.desc: High-resolution air quality modeling framework integrating 7 APIs (WAQI, NASA FIRMS, Open-Meteo, TomTom, OSM, CAMS, OpenFDA) with hybrid IDW modeling, fire-impact and traffic adjustments, visualized on an interactive Folium map.

projects.title: Aspiration Cleantech Ventures
projects.subtitle: MERN Web Platform for a Solar Energy Company
projects.desc: Production MERN-stack web app built during a full-stack internship for a cleantech/solar energy company. JWT authentication, Helmet security hardening, and Cloudinary-based image uploads.

projects.title: sret-noticeboard
projects.subtitle: College Notice Board with Admin Panel & Calendar
projects.desc: Built for my college's notice board system. Role-based auth (student/faculty/admin), an admin dashboard with usage stats, image-attached notices, and a FullCalendar-driven event calendar. Node/Express/MongoDB backend with JWT auth and Multer-based image uploads.

projects.title: Cardio Disease Detection Engine
projects.subtitle: Cardiovascular Risk Dashboard + API
projects.desc: ML system predicting cardiovascular disease risk (High/Low) from patient clinical and lifestyle data. Streamlit dashboard and Flask API backed by a tuned model zoo (Logistic Regression through stacking/voting ensembles), with the best model auto-selected for production.

projects.title: AeroSight
projects.subtitle: Air Quality Forecasting & Health Reporting Toolkit
projects.desc: Air quality analysis and forecasting toolkit combining Prophet and XGBoost dual-model forecasting, correlating pollution with mortality data, and auto-generating multi-page PDF reports for monitoring stations.

projects.title: AI Drug-Food Interactions
projects.subtitle: NLP-Powered Interaction Classifier
projects.desc: NLP + ML web app classifying drug-food interactions into 6 categories using TF-IDF vectorization and ensemble models (99.2% accuracy), with semantic search and a generated knowledge graph.

projects.title: Intel Scene Classification
projects.subtitle: CNN vs VGG16 vs Bagged Ensemble
projects.desc: Image classification on the Intel Image Classification dataset (6 scene classes), comparing a baseline CNN, fine-tuned VGG16 transfer learning, and a bagged-ensemble of Dense heads (~93% test accuracy), with Grad-CAM visualizations and misclassification analysis.

projects.title: GloVe from Scratch
projects.subtitle: Word Embeddings Trained on WikiText-2
projects.desc: GloVe word embeddings built from first principles: sparse co-occurrence matrix (120x smaller than dense), hand-derived gradients verified against autograd, and manual AdaGrad, with no autograd or torch.optim. Trained on WikiText-2 in 26 s on a 4 GB laptop GPU, with analogy tests, ablations and a comparison against official GloVe vectors.

projects.title: ANPR-YOLOv4
projects.subtitle: Automatic Number Plate Recognition
projects.desc: Automatic Number Plate Recognition system using a custom-trained YOLOv4 detector for cars, bikes, and autos. Custom-labeled dataset, Darknet training pipeline, and inference notebook for detecting vehicles and localizing their number plates.

projects.title: Cardiovascular Risk Prediction
projects.subtitle: ML Pipeline for Patient Health Data
projects.desc: End-to-end ML pipeline predicting cardiovascular disease risk from patient health data. Engineered features (BMI, MAP, pulse pressure, hypertension flag, heuristic risk score) feed baseline and tree-based models, evaluated on accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC.

projects.title: T20 Fantasy Impact Model
projects.subtitle: LightGBM Fantasy Team Optimizer
projects.desc: ML-driven T20 cricket fantasy team optimizer. Dual LightGBM models (mean + P90 quantile) trained on ball-by-ball data predict batting runs and bowling impact; a match-day engine then builds an optimal Dream11-style XI under credit/role constraints with captain/vice-captain selection.

projects.title: Aspiration Cleantech Academy
projects.subtitle: Job-Oriented Training Platform
projects.desc: Job-oriented training platform covering HVAC, entrepreneurship, digital marketing, and sales courses. Next.js frontend with an Express/MongoDB backend, built during a digital marketing internship landing-page build.

projects.title: VoteIQ
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Civic Education App
projects.desc: AI-powered civic education assistant helping first-time Indian voters understand the election process. Built in 8 hours at Google's Prompt Wars, featuring a guided voter journey, myth-busting AI module, guarded Q&A assistant, civic maturity scoring, and a readiness quiz.

projects.title: Advanced CLI Web Scrapper
projects.subtitle: Full-Site Archiver Built on Playwright
projects.desc: CLI tool to download full web pages with assets (CSS, JS, images, video) for offline archiving. Handles dynamic/JS-heavy pages, adjustable crawl depth, URL filtering, domain locking, and concurrent downloads.

projects.title: InstaAnalyzer
projects.subtitle: Follower/Following Analysis Script
projects.desc: Python script analyzing Instagram accounts to identify mutual followers and non-followbacks, using Instaloader for data and the Rich library for clean terminal output.

projects.title: Quantum Teleportation Simulation
projects.subtitle: Interactive Browser-Based Quantum Circuit Visualizer
projects.desc: Zero-dependency browser simulator visualizing the quantum teleportation protocol step-by-step, with selectable noise models, an animated quantum circuit, and real-time fidelity metrics.

projects.title: Sudoku Visualisation
projects.subtitle: Algorithm Comparison: Backtracking vs MRV
projects.desc: Graphical Sudoku solver and visualizer built natively in C++ with SFML. Generates puzzles at three difficulty levels and runs a side-by-side timing comparison of Backtracking vs MRV-heuristic solving.

projects.title: Arduino Calc: Matrix Edition
projects.subtitle: Von Neumann CPU Concepts on Real Hardware
projects.desc: Calculator built for a Computer Organization & Architecture course, mapping Von Neumann CPU concepts onto Arduino Uno hardware with a matrix-styled Web Serial interface that needs no Serial Monitor.

projects.title: Urban Farming Simulator
projects.subtitle: OOP Rooftop Farm Management Sim
projects.desc: Text-based rooftop urban farm management simulation modeling crop biology, seasonal weather, and market fluctuations using SOLID principles, encapsulation, and polymorphism. Built with a 3-person team.

projects.title: Crorepati Quiz Game
projects.subtitle: CLI Quiz Game Inspired by KBC
projects.desc: CLI-based quiz game inspired by 'Kaun Banega Crorepati', built in Java with lifelines and escalating prize levels.

projects.title: StyleGAN Exploration
projects.subtitle: Style-Based GAN in TensorFlow/Keras on CIFAR-10
projects.desc: Compact StyleGAN implementation in TensorFlow/Keras for image generation on CIFAR-10, in a single Jupyter notebook. An 8-layer mapping network and AdaIN style modulation drive synthesis, with style mixing and latent interpolation experiments. An educational implementation, not a reproduction of StyleGAN2 or StyleGAN3.

projects.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms Study Guide
projects.subtitle: Student guide to 16 classic algorithms with C code
projects.desc: PDF study guide and C implementations for 16 key algorithms and problems from Anany Levitin's Introduction to the Design and Analysis of Algorithms: searching, sorting, N-Queens, knapsack, Kruskal, Dijkstra, Graham scan, Miller-Rabin and LCS, organised into Basic, Moderate and High difficulty levels.

projects.title: ASPCV WordPress Site
projects.subtitle: Custom Astra child theme and mu-plugins for a cleantech company site
projects.desc: Source-controlled custom code for the corporate website of Aspiration Cleantech Ventures: an Astra child theme with custom page templates, plus must-use plugins for the navigation system and redirects, deployed on WordPress.
